categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three business segments: gene sequencing instruments, laboratory automation, and new business areas including multi-omics tools, ultrasound imaging platforms, and ultra-low temperature automated biobanks. The gene sequencing segment leads the industry with a comprehensive product matrix covering short-read and long-read sequencing technologies. Laboratory automation focuses on intelligent upgrades integrating AI to enhance efficiency and data-driven decision-making. The new business segment develops products for cellomics, spatial omics, proteinomics, and imaging, expanding applications in life sciences and clinical fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary DNBSEQ sequencing technology, pattern array chip technology, optical-mechanical-electrical integration, self-luminescence sequencing, semiconductor image sensors combined with AI, and advanced library preparation methods such as ATOPlex multiplex PCR and microfluidics. The company emphasizes independent development of key raw materials, enzymes, dyes, and sequencing chips, ensuring supply chain autonomy. Production methods involve global manufacturing bases with strict ISO13485 quality management, lean production, and automation including AI+ vision inspection and automated liquid handling systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include research institutions, clinical laboratories, agricultural genomics centers, public health agencies, customs, judicial and educational institutions, and industrial biotech companies. The company serves markets in genomics research, clinical diagnostics (e.g., oncology, infectious diseases, reproductive health), large population cohort studies, molecular breeding, environmental monitoring, and food safety. Major end markets span scientific research, clinical applications, public health, agriculture, and emerging fields like spatial and single-cell omics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global presence with operations and subsidiaries across China (Shenzhen, Wuhan, Changchun, Qingdao, Kunshan, Hangzhou, Hainan), Hong Kong, the United States, Japan, Latvia, Germany, Singapore, the Netherlands, Serbia, Australia, Brazil, New Zealand, and South Korea. It maintains 9 R&D centers, 7 production bases, 9 international spare parts warehouses, and 13 customer experience centers worldwide, serving over 110 countries and regions across six continents.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the life sciences supply chain, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and sales of gene sequencing instruments, reagents, laboratory automation equipment, and related software. It also engages in upstream activities by independently developing core raw materials, enzymes, dyes, and sequencing chips to ensure supply chain security and autonomy.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing full-read-length sequencing technology (SEQ ALL), enhancing throughput, accuracy, speed, and cost-effectiveness of sequencing platforms, and integrating AI deeply into life science tools. The company focuses on multi-omics integration, intelligent laboratory automation (GLI business), and expanding applications in clinical diagnostics, large cohort studies, and emerging fields like spatial and single-cell omics. R&D efforts emphasize proprietary core technologies, patent portfolio expansion, and global regulatory certifications to support international market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of gene sequencing instruments, laboratory automation equipment, and consumables such as sequencing reagents and library preparation kits. The company also earns income from providing after-sales maintenance, technical support services, and software solutions. Sales are conducted via direct sales to end customers and through authorized distributors in various regions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in gene sequencing instruments, competing primarily with Illumina and Thermo Fisher, which together with the company hold approximately 87% of the global market share by revenue. It is the first globally to commercialize large-scale production of both short-read and long-read sequencing products. The company holds a strong position in the domestic Chinese market with a leading share and is expanding its presence internationally despite geopolitical challenges and intense competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.01 billion, a 3.48% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 600.8 million, slightly improved from the previous year. The company invests heavily in R&D, with expenditures accounting for 26.92% of revenue. It has total assets of about RMB 10.31 billion and net assets of approximately RMB 7.89 billion as of year-end 2024. The company’s global installed base of gene sequencing instruments exceeded 4,500 units, with a 28.2% share of global new installations in 2024, up from 18.7% in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary DNBSEQ sequencing technology offering high accuracy, low error rates, and cost efficiency. It uniquely provides a full-read-length sequencing tool matrix combining short-read and long-read platforms, enabling comprehensive genomic analysis. Integration of AI enhances sequencing speed, accuracy, and laboratory automation, facilitating data-driven decision-making. The company’s global regulatory certifications, extensive patent portfolio, and localized global support network differentiate it by ensuring product reliability, compliance, and customer service excellence.
